values.description: API root every request in the collection is built from (used directly as {{base_url}}/..., not /api/v1/... — the prefix must already be included here). Change the host to https://yourdomain.com/api/v1 for production.

Reference only — not wired into any request. The collection has a single Auth > Login request, shared by both roles, so edit its body directly (or keep this here as a reminder of which account the Admin folder expects). Its token goes in the collection variable admin_token, not here: a collection variable shadows one of the same name in the environment.
Reference only — not wired into any request. See admin_email.
